Table S9c. Second-chromosome run settings

Chromosome 22 runs are the sweep settings; chromosome 2 runs use the same individuals. EUR + AFR is also run on chromosome 2 at chromosome 22's vg = 0.01: chance correlations in the 205-person AFR discovery sample inflate the GWAS signal in proportion to total vg, so the two chromosome 2 runs bracket that effect.
